[[File:Peter Topping.jpg|thumb|220px|Peter Topping]]
'''Peter Topping''' (born 1971) is a British mathematician working in [[geometric analysis]].

He obtained his PhD in 1997 at the [[University of Warwick]] under the supervision of Mario Joseph Micallef.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=23917}}</ref> He is currently Professor at the University of Warwick.<ref>[http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/maths/people/staff/peter_topping/ Faculty profile], Univ. of Warwick. Retrieved 21 May 2012.</ref>

In 2005 he was awarded the LMS [[Whitehead Prize]] and in 2006 he was awarded the [[Philip Leverhulme Prize]].<ref>[http://www.maths.warwick.ac.uk/general/news/2006.html#topping Peter Topping awarded 2006 Philip Leverhulme Prize] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140507030257/http://www.maths.warwick.ac.uk/general/news/2006.html#topping |date=7 May 2014 }}, Warwick Mathematics Department. Retrieved 21 May 2012.</ref>

Topping is the author of the 2006 book ''Lectures on the Ricci Flow''.<ref>{{MR|2265040}}</ref> He was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2014 at Seoul.
